original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚NDLEA与澳大利亚警方签署协议打击毒品路线
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家禁毒执法局与澳大利亚联邦警察在阿布贾签署谅解备忘录，同意通过情报共享、联合行动、能力建设和控制下交付等方式打击跨国毒品贩运网络。NDLEA主席称该协议是对跨国毒品卡特尔“宣战”。该消息目前仅来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚国家禁毒执法局与澳大利亚联邦警察签署谅解备忘录
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency and the Australian Federal Police formalised the partnership on Monday through a memorandum of understanding signed at the NDLEA headquarters in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 合作涵盖情报交流、联合行动、能力建设和控制下交付四个领域
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The four areas of cooperation under the agreement are intelligence and information exchange, joint and coordinated operations, capacity building and professional development, and controlled delivery of illicit drugs

key_facts.fact: NDLEA主席称该协议是对跨国毒品卡特尔宣战
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: NDLEA Chairman, Brig Gen Buba Marwa (retd.), described the agreement as “a declaration of war against transnational drug cartels

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
协议具体执行细节与时间表尚未公布
